title: Toronto Author Shaun Goldsmith to Attend Biblio Bash Featuring Critically Acclaimed Debut Thriller "The Spire" | User | mammothtimes.com
text:
Toronto, ON - April 2, 2025 - Award-winning Canadian author Shaun Goldsmith will be among the celebrated writers featured at the Toronto Public Library Foundation’s 2025 Biblio Bash , held Thursday, April 3, at the iconic Toronto Reference Library. This black-tie fundraiser—known as one of the most anticipated literary events in the city—brings together business leaders, philanthropists, bestselling authors, and passionate library supporters for a meaningful night in support of the most-used public library system in North America.
Goldsmith, whose debut novel The Spire has drawn critical acclaim and a loyal readership, will join a roster of celebrated authors, including New York Times bestselling writer Carley Fortune. Donations raised at the event will directly benefit programs and partnerships focused on the social health and mental wellness of teens across Toronto. Since its founding in 1997, the Toronto Public Library Foundation has raised over $117 million thanks to the generous donors and partners.
Goldsmith, who is making waves with his sharp prose and emotionally resonant storytelling, shared his thoughts ahead of the event: “We all recognize the division in today’s world. But books and libraries bring people together. Be it for a love of reading, to study and learn, or to find a sense of community. An event such as this reminds us why that matters. For that reason, if for no other, Biblio Bash is so important.” He added: “It’s a real privilege to be included among so many incredible authors, from Canada and around the world, each telling their own unique story.”
The evening will be hosted by Elamin Abdelmahmoud, author and host of CBC Radio’s Commotion , and promises to be an unforgettable gathering for literary lovers with purpose at its heart. To learn more about Biblio Bash 2025 visit bibliobash.ca .
​ About the Book
The Spire is a gripping thriller set against the rich, contrasting backdrop of New York City. Part mystery, part police procedural, the novel follows veteran detective Mike Vogel as he investigates a brutal mass killing inside an opulent Midtown Manhattan high-rise known as The Spire. A character-driven “howcatchem” laced with moral complexity and emotional depth, Goldsmith’s novel explores themes of ambition, betrayal, fatherhood, and the dark underbelly of privilege. As Literary Titan writes, “The Spire offers an immersive experience into the life and mind of a dedicated detective while painting a vivid picture of New York City’s multifaceted character.”
Grab your copy of The Spire by Shaun Goldsmith today. Available now on Amazon in both Kindle and paperback formats!
About the Author
Shaun Goldsmith is a Canadian author whose debut novel, The Spire , has been praised by Kirkus as “a fine whodunit full of satisfying twists, featuring a well-developed protagonist.” Goldsmith’s work is distinguished by its brisk, impactful writing style and emotionally layered storytelling. With strong influences from noir greats like Elmore Leonard and Raymond Chandler, he delivers a fresh yet familiar voice in the mystery and thriller genre. His writing has received acclaim from both critics and readers, with top ratings on Amazon and Goodreads. The Spire is not only a tightly plotted detective story but also an exploration of resilience, the choices people make under pressure, and the human cost of ambition. Goldsmith lives in Toronto, where he continues to write and champion the importance of storytelling in building stronger communities.
